name: storage cleanup reports and local file policies > compares the checked-out branch without a full status
reason: git 2.56.0 on the ubuntu-24.04 runner reports a gitfile pointing at a removed repository as "gitfile does not point to a valid repository"; storageCleanup.ts only recognises "not a git repository", so the cleanup reports failed instead of kept. Upstream CI on git 2.55.0 passes.
removeWhen: storageCleanup.ts recognises the git 2.56 message, or the test passes on the ubuntu-24.04 runner without this entry.
